name: Aurora Noise-Cancelling Headset
summary: Over-ear wireless headset with active noise cancellation, 30h battery, and USB-C fast charge. Best for remote workers and frequent travelers.

name: Nimbus Standing Desk
summary: Electric height-adjustable standing desk with memory presets and a 60-inch bamboo top. Ergonomic for home offices.

name: Solstice Smart Lamp
summary: App-controlled LED lamp with circadian tuning and voice assistant support. Great for focused evening work.

name: Vortex Mechanical Keyboard
summary: Hot-swappable mechanical keyboard with low-profile switches and per-key RGB. Built for programmers.

name: Cascade Ergo Chair
summary: Mesh office chair with adjustable lumbar support and 4D armrests. Reduces back strain during long sessions.
